description: Quote a buy of Obsidian Cherry for a given USD amount: how many tokens a buy would mint right now (buy price = share x 1.02), whether this would be the pool's very first buy (which seeds one token to a burn address, decision 28), and whether buying is currently paused by a reserve shortfall. Does not execute anything — read-only. Requires: usd.

usd.description: Dollar amount to quote, e.g. '10' or '10.00'

name: obsidian_quote
